Engineering BEng/MEng at Durham University

What Durham University asks of applicants to Engineering BEng/MEng for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All Durham University courses · Engineering field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 0 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma at a school offering AP: SAT/ACT is not required on its own — for a A*AA course it is one of the options for the third qualification alongside two AP exams at 5, 5 (SAT 1350 (min 700 RW, 650 M) or ACT 30, or an honours course at A+, or a year-long dual-enrolment/college course at A)
  • Three AP exams at 5, 5, 5 meet the same requirement without SAT/ACT

Not re-checked automatically. Confirm this on the university’s page.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Durham: General Engineering H100 (September 2027)
English language
  • Durham Direct Entry Band B (Engineering, undergraduate)
  • IELTS (UKVI/SELT or non-UKVI) 6.5 with no component under 6.0
  • TOEFL iBT:
    • 80 with no component under 20 (tests before 21 Jan 2026)
    • 4.5 with no component under 4 (tests from 21 Jan 2026)
  • Pearson Academic PTE 62 (no less than 59 in each skill); Duolingo 120 (no sub-score below 110); Cambridge C1/C2 176 (169 per component)

Required where English is not the applicant’s first language; Durham lists exemptions for recognised English-speaking countries. Not re-checked automatically. Confirm this on the university’s page.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Durham: English language levels required · Durham: Direct Entry Band B

Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement: 2 AP exams
  • Official (A*AA course): three AP exams at 5, 5, 5, or two AP exams at 5, 5 plus one of SAT/ACT, an honours course or a year-long dual-enrolment course
  • A required A-level Mathematics must be shown by AP Calculus BC at grade 5
  • AP exams must be sat and submitted — the AP course grade is not accepted; AP Capstone (AP Research, AP Seminar) does not count

Official (2027 entry): for a A*AA course, three AP exams at 5, 5, 5, or two AP exams at 5, 5 plus one additional qualification (SAT, ACT, honours course or dual-enrolment course). Two AP exams alone do not meet the requirement. Students at schools without AP may use honours courses with an overall GPA of 3.7.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Durham: General Engineering H100 (September 2027)
